commit.message:
feat: synchronize deployment and infrastructure for multi-app Docker and Kubernetes

- Add dynamic app discovery system that automatically finds apps with manifest.yaml
- Create universal Docker deployment with docker-compose.dynamic.yml for infrastructure
- Implement Dockerfile.template for building any app container
- Add deploy-apps.py script for generating Docker and Kubernetes configurations
- Enhanced deploy.sh with full CLI support for multiple deployment modes
- Update Kubernetes manifests for kailash-platform namespace with multi-database support
- Add comprehensive DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md with examples and best practices
- Support for development, staging, and production environments
- Built-in monitoring stack with Prometheus and Grafana
- Automatic health checks and service discovery
- Secrets management for both Docker and Kubernetes
- Support for deploying specific apps or all apps at once

This enables seamless deployment of multiple apps from repositories created with this template.
